user.title: Kilowahti — Basic settings
user.description: Region determines which European bidding zone's prices are used.

data_description.name: Used in entity names, e.g. 'Home'
data_description.price_resolution: 15 minutes (96 slots/day) or 1 hour (24 slots/day). Match your contract's metering interval.

currency.title: Kilowahti — Currency
currency.description: This region bills in {currency}. Spot prices are converted from EUR with a daily exchange rate; all prices you enter (commission, transfer tiers, thresholds) are in the selected display currency.

data.fx_rate: Manual exchange rate (local currency per EUR)

data_description.fx_rate: Used when the exchange rate source is manual, and as a fallback when the automatic rate is unavailable. Leave at 0 if unused.

vat_and_tax.title: VAT & electricity tax
vat_and_tax.description: Pre-filled from your region. Adjust if needed. All prices (transfer tiers, fixed periods) are entered incl. VAT.

data_description.electricity_tax: Flat per-kWh electricity tax added on top of spot/fixed price.
data_description.spot_commission: Retailer's per-kWh commission added on top of the spot price. Enter gross (VAT included). Leave at 0 if not applicable.
data_description.monthly_fixed_cost: Fixed monthly fee from your electricity contract (e.g. basic service fee). Gross amount (VAT included). Leave at 0 if not applicable.

transfer_groups.title: Transfer pricing
transfer_groups.description: Organise transfer price tiers into named groups (e.g. Time-of-use, Seasonal, General). Only one group is active at a time. You can skip this and configure groups later in Options.

data_description.monthly_fixed_cost: Grid connection + contract base fee. Gross amount (VAT included).
Grid connection + contract base fee. Gross amount (VAT included).

transfer_group_detail.title: Edit group

add_transfer_tier.title: Add transfer price
add_transfer_tier.description: Evaluated in priority order; first match wins. Add a base rate as the lowest priority with no time constraints.

edit_transfer_tier.title: Edit transfer price
edit_transfer_tier.description: Change any field, or tick removal to delete this tier.

data_description.max_price: When the current slot's price is at or below this, the price_acceptable sensor turns on.
data_description.price_threshold_includes_transfer: ON: compare total price (spot + transfer). OFF: compare energy price only (spot).
data_description.max_rank: When the current slot's rank is at or below this, the rank_acceptable sensor turns on.
data_description.forward_avg_hours: Number of hours ahead to average for the next_hours_avg sensor.
data_description.control_factor_function: Shape of the 0–1 control factor curve.
data_description.control_factor_scaling: Exponent applied to control factor (amplifies extremes).

score_profiles.title: Optimization scores
score_profiles.description: Scores measure how well your consumption is shifted to cheap hours. The permanent 'Total' profile covers all consumption — link a meter (or meters) to it in Options after setup.

advanced_options.title: Advanced options
advanced_options.description: Configure how sensor values are displayed in Home Assistant.

data.expose_price_arrays: Expose spot price arrays as sensor attributes (increases DB size)
data.expose_total_price_arrays: Expose total price arrays as sensor attributes (increases DB size)

data_description.expose_price_arrays: Writes today_prices and tomorrow_prices arrays to the spot_price sensor attributes, which are then stored in the database. Makes dashboard graphs easier to build, but is not required for displaying them and adds unnecessary DB load.
data_description.expose_total_price_arrays: Writes today_prices and tomorrow_prices arrays to the total_price sensor attributes, each entry carrying the energy and transfer breakdown. Same database load as the spot price arrays.
data_description.high_precision: When on, price sensors and price array attributes show more decimals. Internal calculations always use full precision.
data_description.show_rolling_averages: Adds sensors for average price over the next 30, 60, and 120 minutes.
data_description.generation_enabled: Enables export price, battery, and arbitrage sensors and services. Configure generation settings in the Generation & export settings menu.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check your network.
error.invalid_region: The selected region returned no data from the API.
error.tier_hour_range: End time must be greater than start time.
error.period_invalid_dates: End date must be on or after start date.
error.period_overlap: This period overlaps with an existing fixed-price period.
error.period_price_zero: Price must be greater than zero.

basic.title: Basic settings
basic.description: Warning: changing the display unit after sensors have been created will cause unit mismatches in history graphs. You may need to clear sensor history or adjust dashboard cards manually.

data.fx_rate: Manual exchange rate (local currency per EUR)

data_description.currency_mode: Switching converts your entered prices (thresholds, commissions, transfer tiers, fixed periods) with the current exchange rate. Review values after switching.

data_description.formula: Default formula: 50 = good, 37.5 at even distribution (penalises average usage). Raw formula: 50 at even distribution (neutral baseline).

fixed_periods.title: Fixed-price periods / fixed contracts
fixed_periods.description: Manage fixed-price periods or fixed contracts. When active, effective_price shows the set fixed price instead of spot.

generation_settings.title: Generation & export settings
generation_settings.description: Configure export pricing and battery settings. Set battery capacity to 0 to disable battery sensors.

data_description.export_commission: Spot-linked mode only. Seller's margin deducted from the spot API price (excl. VAT). Small producers typically don't collect VAT on exports.
data_description.fixed_export_rate: Fixed mode only. Flat rate you receive per exported kWh.
data_description.solar_window_start: Start hour of your typical solar production window (used by next_solar_window_avg sensor).
data_description.solar_window_end: End hour (exclusive) of your typical solar production window.

data_description.price: Enter price incl. VAT. This price is used as-is — no VAT is added.

error.period_invalid_dates: End date must be on or after start date.
error.period_overlap: This period overlaps with an existing fixed-price period.

price_became_acceptable.name: Price became acceptable
price_became_acceptable.description: Triggers when the current electricity price drops to an acceptable level (at or below the price threshold).

price_no_longer_acceptable.name: Price no longer acceptable
price_no_longer_acceptable.description: Triggers when the current electricity price rises above the price threshold.

rank_became_acceptable.name: Rank became acceptable
rank_became_acceptable.description: Triggers when the current price rank drops to an acceptable level (at or below the rank threshold).

rank_no_longer_acceptable.name: Rank no longer acceptable
rank_no_longer_acceptable.description: Triggers when the current price rank rises above the rank threshold.

became_cheapest_slot.name: Became cheapest slot
became_cheapest_slot.description: Triggers when the current time slot becomes the cheapest of the day.

fixed_period_started.name: Fixed period started
fixed_period_started.description: Triggers when a fixed-price period becomes active.

fixed_period_ended.name: Fixed period ended
fixed_period_ended.description: Triggers when a fixed-price period stops being active.

tomorrow_prices_available.name: Tomorrow's prices available
tomorrow_prices_available.description: Triggers when tomorrow's electricity prices become available.

price_is_acceptable.name: Price is acceptable
price_is_acceptable.description: Passes when the current electricity price is at or below the price threshold.

rank_is_acceptable.name: Rank is acceptable
rank_is_acceptable.description: Passes when the current price rank is at or below the rank threshold.

price_is_lowest_today.name: Price is lowest today
price_is_lowest_today.description: Passes when the current time slot is the cheapest of the day.

fixed_period_active.name: Fixed period active
fixed_period_active.description: Passes when a fixed-price period is currently active.

tomorrow_available.name: Tomorrow's prices available
tomorrow_available.description: Passes when tomorrow's electricity prices are available.
